messages:
Julia: Heads-up — HearthlyAI asked for a focused onboarding + optimization workshop next week. They want dedicated time on routing policies, batching config, and rollout plan. Dates they suggested: Tue/Wed next week (US morning). Who can lead and what prep do we need? cc @Maya @Liam

Maya: I can lead Tue 10am PT / Wed 11am PT. Recommend 90m: 30m install & infra, 30m configs (batching/KV cache), 30m Q&A + next steps. Need a pre-read: their current traffic profile + sample traces.

Liam: I can provide the demo infra. Will provision a dedicated sandbox with a small dedicated pool. Need CS to confirm dataset and PII handling. Also can record the session.

Sanjay: Quick reminder — renewal in ~6 weeks; this workshop is high-impact for their confidence. Let's make sure we show cost/latency wins. I can do a 10-min cost-slides segment.

Julia: @OnboardBot can you drop a doodle + calendar invites? Also collect 3 customer questions in advance and a single poll for "main concern" (latency / cost / security / other).

OnboardBot: Doodle created: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123 — tentative calendar invites sent to hearthlyai-team@hearthly.ai. Meeting set to 90m. Recording enabled. Pre-read template: https://redwood.dev/templates/onboard-preread

Amir (HearthlyAI): Thanks — Tue 10am PT works best for our engineering leads. We'll send peak QPS and token counts by EOD tomorrow.

Maya: For pre-reads, ask them for: 1) peak QPS, 2) 99th latency SLO, 3) list of private vs hosted models, 4) sample traces (optional). I'll draft the email and post here by EOD.

Julia: Also let's prepare a short rollback/runbook snippet for canary rollouts. Minimal snippet to include in the runbook:

```
if error_rate > 1%:
  rollback to previous model_version
  notify #incidents + oncall
```

Keep it short and actionable.

Liam: Sandbox specs: 2xA10G, 40GB RAM, preloaded with sample dataset. ETA: 48h after we get dataset confirmation.

Sanjay: I'll add a slide showing projected cost delta using batching and quantization. Need their current monthly token usage to model it.

Maya: I'll send the pre-read email by EOD. Who wants a dry run on Friday? @Liam @Sanjay

Liam: I can do Friday 9am PT.

Julia: Perfect — I'll slot the prep and send invites. Thanks team :rocket:
